custom_nbmjg4py.name: Grand Propylaea

custom_geometry.code: const group = new THREE.Group(); const baseGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, 0.5, depth); const base = new THREE.Mesh(baseGeo); base.position.y = -height/2 + 0.25; group.add(base); const colHeight = height - 3.5; const colGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.45, colHeight, 16); const colSpacing = (width - 2) / 5; for(let i=0; i<6; i++) { const colFront = new THREE.Mesh(colGeo); colFront.position.set(-width/2 + 1 + i * colSpacing, -height/2 + 0.5 + colHeight/2, depth/2 - 1); group.add(colFront); const colBack = new THREE.Mesh(colGeo); colBack.position.set(-width/2 + 1 + i * colSpacing, -height/2 + 0.5 + colHeight/2, -depth/2 + 1); group.add(colBack); } const entGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, 1, depth); const ent = new THREE.Mesh(entGeo); ent.position.y = -height/2 + 0.5 + colHeight + 0.5; group.add(ent); const pedShape = new THREE.Shape(); pedShape.moveTo(-width/2, 0); pedShape.lineTo(width/2, 0); pedShape.lineTo(0, 2); pedShape.lineTo(-width/2, 0); const pedGeo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(pedShape, { depth: depth, bevelEnabled: false }); const ped = new THREE.Mesh(pedGeo); ped.position.set(0, -height/2 + 0.5 + colHeight + 1, -depth/2); group.add(ped); return group;
